problem: Owner has the original PNGs but still had to select eligible orders and click the manual preview button in16.2.
implemented_behavior: Default-on local automatic selection and preview after opening production, PNG import/restore, eligible source refresh and explicit kit recipe confirmation.
Existing100-line/50-order/300-print/20-sheet limits are reused; unconfirmed kits, missing/low-resolution arts, cancelled/reserved/printed/review rows remain out.
Identical planning inputs preserve the same canvas; changed inputs invalidate the old preview immediately. Dirty settings must be saved/loaded first.
Manual selection/clear disables automatic reselection; the explicit checkbox resumes automatic mode. A pending asynchronous render can be cancelled or discarded after account/session/source changes.
Automatic selection updates checkboxes without replacing action buttons under pointer focus. Queue buttons become usable again after busy operations.
No reservation, PNG download, physical confirmation or financial entry is performed by automatic preview. Existing server rechecks/CAS/idempotence stay unchanged.
